text:
ITEM 1 | Rectangular slice with a golden-brown, blistered top showing dark brown spots and charred patches over pale white cheese-like layer; edges pale cream with a thin orange-red sauce band along one side; sits on the lower right of the plate, about 9 cm long by 4 cm wide and roughly 1.5 cm thick, with a flat, slightly moist surface and sheen from melted fat | 150

ITEM 2 | Pale cream-colored, bread-like base beneath the topping, lightly golden on the underside edges, flat rectangular crust about 9 cm by 4 cm and about 1 cm thick, firm and dry-looking, sits directly under the topping slice | 60

ITEM 3 | Tomato-orange sauce visible in a thin band between the crust and the cheese along the right edge of the slice, glossy and moist, about 0.5 cm wide strip, sits on the crust | 10

ITEM 4 | Bone-in chicken-like piece with a cooked, pale tan to light golden skin, slightly torn and browned in spots, with a visible drumstick-shaped bone end protruding on the upper right; flesh is pale and fibrous, roughly 8 cm long by 4 cm wide, sits at the top right of the plate beside the pizza-like slice | 110

ITEM 5 | Second piece of similar pale tan, lightly browned cooked meat with a rounded, lumpy surface, dotted with small green herb flecks and a purple-blue tinted patch on one side, roughly 6 cm by 4 cm, sits next to Item 4 at the top center of the plate | 90

ITEM 6 | Small green herb leaves scattered over the meat pieces, bright green, flat and fresh-looking, a few sprigs about 2 cm across, sitting on top of Items 4 and 5 | 5
